zh: 消息本身不超过 K 时原样输出；否则只能保留完整单词组成的前缀，并在后面加一个空格和省略号，整体长度不能超过 K。
前缀越长，“前缀 + 空格 + ...”就越长，长度随单词数单调增加。所以从第一个单词开始逐个尝试加入，第一次超限就停止，之前的就是最长可行前缀。
若消息长度 ≤ K 直接输出；否则按空格拆出单词，逐个尝试：把当前已选单词加上新单词用空格连接，再加上“ ...”（4 个字符），若总长超过 K 就停止，否则接受这个单词；最后若一个单词都没选上输出“...”，否则输出已选单词加“ ...”。
en: If the message fits within K, print it unchanged; otherwise you may only keep a prefix of complete words followed by a space and an ellipsis, and the whole thing must not exceed K characters.

The longer the prefix, the longer "prefix + space + ..." becomes, so the length grows monotonically with the number of words. Try adding words one at a time from the first; stop at the first one that overflows, and what you have is the longest feasible prefix.

If the message length is at most K, print it; otherwise split it into words and try them in order: join the chosen words and the new word with spaces, append " ..." (4 characters), and stop if the total exceeds K, otherwise accept the word; finally print "..." if no word was accepted, else the accepted words followed by " ...".

explanationEn:
## Approach

Try adding complete words one at a time, and keep only the longest prefix whose length with the ellipsis does not exceed K.

## Proof of correctness

The prefix length increases monotonically, so once the first prefix overflows, every longer prefix is infeasible too; the whole-word rule forbids cutting inside a word.

## Complexity

O(|message|) time, O(|message|) space.
